business_question: Which product categories generated the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC;

analysis.summary: Electronics generated the highest revenue among all product categories, generating ₹20,39,938 and accounting for over 50% of total sales receipts.
key_findings: Electronics is the highest revenue-generating category at ₹20,39,938.
Home & Kitchen is the second-highest category at ₹4,75,275, followed closely by Sports at ₹4,32,477.
The top three categories together account for 72.8% of total enterprise revenue.
Long-tail categories (Groceries, Books, Beauty) each contribute under ₹2,00,000 to the total.
recommendations: Investigate the factors contributing to Electronics performance and high-velocity SKUs.
Analyze monthly seasonal Electronics trends to ensure adequate buffer stock during peak demand.
Explore promotional bundling strategies between Home & Kitchen and Sports to expand average order value.
Evaluate inventory holding and warehouse costs for lower-volume categories like Beauty and Books.
data_quality_and_limitations: Includes only completed orders; refunded, cancelled, and pending orders have been filtered out.
Analysis covers all 8 active product categories recorded in the current fiscal calendar.
